contexts.text: Such as is the subject, such is the predicate.
From the subject is made the predication.
That which is predicated is circumstanced according to the quality of that of which it is predicated.
This is why human properties are predicated of Jehovah... AC 592.
From the subject is known what is predicated.
Way is predicated of truths. AC 627:3.
Such dimensions cannot be predicated of spiritual and celestial things...
Nothing holy can be predicated of (such truths).
They who have preached the Lord and faith with so much eloquence... and have not done it from the heart, in the other life are those who hate the Lord the most, and persecute the faithful. AC 3489:2.
Esse cannot be predicated of those things which cease to be...
To preach the Lord from the doctrine of love and charity. Signified.
When the man can be regenerated, it is predicated of the Lord that He sees him...
When land is predicated of the inhabitant, the signification is circumstanced according to the Thing concerning which is the predication... AC 2184:4.
This is a common formula of preachers.
All things are circumstanced predicatedly to the things being treated of.

To such a degree are the words in the Word predicated of their own goods and truths, that merely from a knowledge of the predication of such words, it can be known what subject in general is being treated of.
To instruct and preach the good and truth of faith from the Knowledges in the Word... from themselves, for the sake of their own honour and gain... Signified.
With such... the goods and truths they have... preached are taken away...
Their zeal is merely a fervour thence; (for) they can preach against their own veriest life with a like zeal...
Not the preaching of the apostles is treated of...
Preachings of falsity. Signified.
Shall be preached () = shall be made known.
Frequent churches-; hear preachings...
Priests and presbyters who preach holy things, and yet live and believe evilly...

Joseph dreamed... = preaching about Him... As the dream treats of Joseph, it = to preach about the Lord's Divine Human... In ancient times. Divine truths were manifested... through speech, visions, or dreams, and the preachings were from them... Illustrated.
To prophesy, here, = to teach and to preach; but from the dreams of a lie, from which was their preaching.
When this Church begins, they preach charity, but only from what is doctrinal... In course of time... they preach faith; and at last... faith alone.
The contents of the preaching. Signified.

Many of those who have preached the Lord in the world, there utterly deny Him... They had preached Him because it was enjoined by their office, and because they had thereby gained honours and wealth...
Contempt and aversion still greater on account of the preaching of truth. Signified, Explained.
Indignation on account of the preaching of truth concerning the Lord's Divine Human. Signified. AC 4726. AC 4730.
The predication of a name is circumstanced predicatedly to the Thing in its series.
Some of these (despisers of the Lord) preach Him, and move the common people to sighs and tears.
They had frequented temples where the Word is preached...
The Christian Church at this day preaches faith alone...
It has become customary to say feed, when the discourse is concerning preaching, or concerning instruction from doctrine or the Word.

Evil priests... who can preach the doctrinals of their own Church with such ardour and simulated zeal... For the thought of honour and gain reigns in them universally, and from this fire are they excited so to preach.
Preaching. Signified.
Under Piety, see this reference.
Some of those who (injected scandals) had been preachers... and could then by their preachings... move the common people to tears...
They place Divine worship in... hearing preachings, etc.
Such things are presented to the Angels... when the Word of our Earth is read and preached.
To teach in the streets = to preach truths from the Lord's Word; for they formerly preached in the streets, because streets = the truths of the doctrine of the Church.

There are many such in Hell, who are present with and inspire... preachers who imitate Divine worship through affections of good and truth from proprium; which is permitted by the Lord, because they thus perform a use; for good men receive the Word from them well; because the Word, from whosesoever mouth it goes forth, is received by a man according to the quality of his good.
Spirit who had been a very pathetic preacher. (Compare SE 4832.)
The preacher who was with me was then explored as to his ideas of the three Divine Persons. See SE 4832:4.
The preacher who was with me... was let into that Earth...
The preacher was greatly delighted with that virgin...
The preacher was brought into the state in which he had been in the world when he wanted to preach...
(In the Sixth Earth) they hear preachings; and the preacher... teaches them truths Divine which lead to the good of life. (The preachers know these truths) from revelation. Explained.
The preachings (in Heaven) are according to the doctrines; and... there are temples in which the preachings take place.
The preachings in the temples are of service only as means for their instruction in the Things of life.

The preacher stands in a pulpit on the east; before his face sit those who are pre-eminently in the light of wisdom, and to the right and left of these, those who are less so. They recline in the form of a circus, so that all are in view of the preacher. At the two sides, where his view does not go, there is no one... No one is allowed to stand behind the pulpit: if anyone is there, the preacher is confused. It is the same if anyone in the congregation dissents; and therefore he must avert his face. The preachings are made with such wisdom, that those in the world cannot be compared to them; for in the Heavens they are in interior light.

All the preachers are from the Spiritual Kingdom... because in that kingdom they are in truths from good; and all preaching is made from truths. The reason there are none from the Celestial Kingdom, is that there they are in the good of love; and therefrom they see and perceive truths, but do not speak about them... And yet there are preachings there also, because they are thereby illustrated in the truths which they had known, and are perfected by many which they had not known before. As soon as they hear them, they acknowledge them, and thus perceive them...

All the preachers are appointed by the Lord, and thence are in the gift of preaching; and no others are allowed to teach in the temples. They are called preachers; not priests; for the reason that the priesthood of Heaven is the Celestial Kingdom...
All the doctrines according to which the preachings are made, regard life as the end...
The things which (the celestial Angels) hear from preaching do not enter into their memory; but immediately into the perception and the will, and become of the life.

Those who in the world have loved the Word, and from longing have sought out truths there... for the sake of the use of life... in Heaven are in illustration and in the light of wisdom... and discharge the office of preachers; and those who excel in wisdom from illustration are in a higher place.
Man learns spiritual goods from reading the Word, and from preaching.
(The English) complain of the preachers at the west (of London, who leave it doubtful) whether good is to be done or not.
These preachers are deprived of the priesthood.
They grow warm with God... as when a preacher is speaking from zeal.
Uses for receiving the Spiritual from the Lord... are imbibed from... preachings and books; and in the Christian world, through doctrines and preachings from the Word.
Whatever comes forth derives from its form... that which is called predicate...
It is a law of the Divine Providence that man be led and taught through the Word, doctrine, and preachings from it... General article. DP 171, Explained.
That this is done mediately through preachings, does not take away what is immediate. Explained.
This is also according to the knowledge of preachers, who say that they speak not from themselves, but from the Spirit of God...
As, according to these laws, there is (only) mediate influx through the Word, doctrine, and preachings... dissensions and heresies are inevitable...
The priest who believes that he preaches from a holy zeal, prays that the Holy Spirit may teach him... and when their preaching is praised, they piously reply that they have spoken... from God.
The interiors of that doctrine are the things put forth ill... their preachings.

I saw a strong Angel proclaiming with a great voice () = the Divine truth... inflowing deeply into the thought... That which is proclaimed with power inflows deeply into the thought. ( = exploration from the Lord's influx. AE 302.)
(The preaching of the solifidian clergy not understood.)
Lo, he lies dead in the street... who preached repentance... and the man Christ only.
Did not the Lord Himself preach (these things); and command His disciples to preach the same?
There are temples in Heaven, and preachings in them... NJHD 7, Explained.
Substance not formed is not anything, because nothing can be predicated of it; and a subject without predicates is an entity of no reason.
Good without some attribute is of no predication...
As, of love and wisdom spaces and times cannot be predicated, but states...
Therefore they are called predications... and, after death, imputations. For predications are made by a man according to his rational lumen... and imputations are made by the Lord...
That the dogmas of the present Church cannot be preached without great caution...
As these three universal predications of the Divine Essence are not understood...
These are four predications of the grace of the one God in His Human.
These four predicates of the Human of God the Father. Explained.
Those who worship nature... as it were cast faith and charity into a bag behind their backs; and, while they are preaching and teaching, they hang it before them like a kind of ruminatory stomach...
Ideas are predicable only of thought.
All the apostles preached faith... in the Lord Jesus Christ.
The quality of every love is predicated according to the end...
Charity cannot be predicated of this.
Esse can be predicated of spiritual life (only).
See Pray.
A holiness merely predicated...

(Thus) the mere predication of holiness to the Word and the sacraments... does indeed impress holiness. But when the holiness itself is disclosed... the predication (or preaching) of it becomes the acknowledgement of it.
These preachers are deprived of the priesthood (because) they do not frame their discourses from the Word, and thus from the Spirit of God, but from their own rational lumen. Described.
This is called the subject; the rest... are called predicates...
The faith which is preached to be given without works...
Such are evil pastors, and preachers.
(Preachers who deny what they have zealously preached here.)
He had preached like an Angel.
Who does not believe in the life after death when he hears a preacher ardent...
Sometimes there is such persuasive preaching that those who believe nothing seem to be elevated into Heaven...
That evil preachers can preach with spurious persuasion and zeal.
In like manner preachers [treat] the things in the Word: they do not see the things which are repugnant...
The preacher, or instructor (of a certain Spirit. Tr.). SE 3432. SE 3435. SE 3445. SE 3450. SE 3455. SE 3461. SE 3462. SE 3463.
There would (in that case) be no need for his preaching...
a. That these things are not to be expounded so as to move the affections; for thus not much remains. Representation.
As preachers are wont to do, who accustom themselves to these things, in order to move (others)...
So with a preacher of evil life when he is preaching goods: the evil Spirits think the same... But when the preacher is in his own life, the evil Spirits dominate.
As many of those with whom I have spoken were preachers...
They had preached in this way... When they had preached well, they said...
As with preachers...
Those in charity and conscience know as it were from themselves all the Knowledges of faith... They can preach also all truths and goods...
Those who have preached goods and truths, and... have thought differently... SE 4324.
Preachers who said that they had preached... when in externals...
A hypocrite, when let into the exterior state, spoke... as preachers do...
Therefore in his last years he did not want to preach.
On the state of evil preachers when they are preaching. Explained.
He felt I was present, and therefore could not preach.
Because they have preached clandestinely...

They are distinguished by the priest who is preaching; for the thoughts of their minds are communicated. But those who come with a mind to hear whether the things he preaches are true... impede the preacher so that he cannot preach; and he therefore admonishes them to go out. Hence other preachers can rarely be present, because they observe such things; and therefore those of them who are there, hide themselves in a certain way, lest they should take away from the preacher the spirit of holiness.

They have Churches in the other life, and they preach, in some places continually, so that persons can enter and go out at all times... They can be discriminated by the preacher merely from their situation...

But when one of another doctrine comes thither, and thinks therefrom about the things which are being preached, the preacher is disturbed, and cannot preach; and therefore they either sit with averted faces, or else go out... The intelligent preachers know this... for the affection is completely varied according to... the turning of the face to them.
I was in such a temple, and heard one preaching, but with averted face; because it is my custom to think about the things which are being preached...

Preachers (with rare exceptions) except the simple, are in persuasive faith that the truth is according to their doctrine... Within reign enviousness and hostility... but there are some who are interiorly good; that is, who suffer themselves to be led by the Lord.

They perceive in what affection the preacher is... Preachers are distressed by this, hardly knowing what to say. In this lies the difference between the preachings in the other life and the preachings in the world: in the world the affection of the love of self and of gain may sound like the affection of the love of good. (Explained.)
On the Hell of preachers who care nothing for the Word and for doctrine from the Word.
Thus do preachers speak, each from his doctrine, without interior ideas; letting themselves solely into exterior affections...
The preachers (in the other life) preach on the Word.
As many preachers are wont to do; who, when in their preaching, believe that it is so... SE 5917:end.
Preachers sometimes visit the maidens there, and examine them.
There are preachers there for the infants.
Melancthon has preached sometimes...

On women who preach. - Women who think about religious things like men, and speak much about them; and still more if they preach in meetings; lose the feminine nature, which is that of affection... and become material, so that affection perishes, and the interiors are closed. They also begin to rave in their thoughts, which takes place because the destroyed affection causes the Intellectual to rave. In the external form they can indeed appear like other women. In a word, they become sensuous in the ultimate degree; the former at home; and the others where the preachings are.
Those in the spiritual love of truth, which is perceived by their delight in hearing preachings...
On the temples and preachings. Explained.

It is from this cause that all hear the preaching unanimously as one man; (for) if the preacher says anything which is opposed, they all refuse in their minds to accept it; and this is noticed by the preacher; for he then feels such a resistance that he can scarcely utter those things, and this with variety according to the resistance. But when they accept, the preacher is as it were in his illustration, and easily utters, teaches, and confirms these things. When there is resistance, the preacher does indeed know the source of it; but still he turns himself hither and thither; namely, to those who are in the head there, to those in the breast, in the loins, and in the feet. Those in the feet do not perceive as the rest do, and therefore he can say what he likes before them, but still he cannot keep his sight with them long, and is therefore compelled to try with various things what will fall into the hearing; and, when he has found it, he urges it in his preaching.

When anyone... hears him, and looks into Heaven, the thoughts of all are varied, and are kept in the hearing of truths, and if these are not being preached rightly, the preacher wavers, tries, sticks fast, until he comes into truths; and, when he teaches them, the hearers all acknowledge and receive... Hence it is evident that the Lord disposes all in the temple by means of Angels and Spirits above or outside of them...

A certain one said that they hear and receive from delight whatever the preacher says, and hence there is rarely any resistance; but he was told that delight derived from habit admits whatever is said; but this delight alone effects nothing; for it does not teach or amend them; but if the delight is to learn truths... it does teach and affect, and thus amend; for it passes into the life and heart, and the Lord then leads the man by means of it, even when he is unaware of it.

Hence preachers who (have been in faith alone) in the world, cannot preach in the Spiritual World; for although they are compelled to preach life and good acts, it is heard from their tone that they understand no other good acts than merely moral and civil ones... and therefore they are no longer allowed to preach; but only those who in the world have understood spiritual works.
[Conversation] with the English about their preachers. - They do not love the elegance of their sermons... They tell them to omit such things, because they do not learn anything. Example(s).
These preachers are at last removed...
There is doctrinal adultery with the preachers in Hell...
They preached similarly as in England, mystically...
The preachers prevailed...

A preacher who loves himself and the world above all things... can speak as from zeal for the Divine... and (then) think in like manner. But this state is the state of his thought from the memory of the body... for, when left alone, he thinks contrary to those things...
Very few live thus from the doctrine (of faith alone); although it is believed by the preachers, that all [do so] who hear their preachings...

This (good of life) the doctors and leaders preach when they are preaching from the Word, and this they teach everyone who approaches the Holy Supper... But as soon as they return... to their doctrine of justification by faith alone, they no longer believe those things... AE 250:5. AE 250:end.
To proclaim with a great voice = exploration from the influx of the Lord.
Is predicated of...
(John the Baptist) preached according to the predictions in the Word...
The holy preaching of Divine truth. Representation.
Predicates follow their subjects.
I. Let a man... learn from preachings the dogmas of his religion.
This is why those who institute preachings from the Word appear as if they were in truths; yet the same persons, when they make preachings from doctrine... are in falsities.
A like preaching, etc., with those who separate faith from the life of faith. Signified, Explained.
To speak = preaching from doctrine; thus doctrine and the derivative preaching. Explained.
A man preaches... from the Lord when he lives according to the laws of his religion... He is taught by the Lord daily... what to preach, etc.

With (the celestial Angels) truths are in the life... and do not manifest themselves except before the perception while... their ministers are preaching them from the Word. They are also perfected... from preachings, etc.
As the celestial Angels are perfected in wisdom through hearing, there are intermediate Angels, who are called celestial spiritual Angels, who preach and teach truths in their temples.
The preaching of the Lord's justice from His Spiritual Kingdom. Signified, Explained.
The preaching of the Lord's justice from His Celestial Kingdom, Signified, Explained.
The Word is in each Heaven... and preachings are made from it, as on earth.
The Divine Essence... is the predicate, and God... is the subject; and therefore to say that the Essence is God, is to say that the predicate is the subject...
That the Lord does not teach man truths immediately... but mediately through preachings, etc... and that man is then illustrated according to the affection of truth from use. Explained.
(The English) hear preachers of faith alone... and, when they hear it, the preaching sounds as if full of wisdom... but when they go home, they know nothing of what has been said...

Preachers who know something of the doctrine of their Church, after they have been instructed in the schools, and have arrived at their functions, care for them and for the Word no further than that they can preach... and thus live in idleness... and are not Christians. They are sent into the Hell in the northern quarter... and then become stupid.
A preacher who appeared like the dragon...

All those preachers who had confirmed themselves in faith alone... are not admitted to preach; the sacerdotal garment is taken away from them; and they afterwards do not know that they have been preachers. Very many are admitted to preach; but as soon as they preach faith alone... all go out... and thus those preachers who can recede are amended: they receive the doctrine of Heaven...
The (English) preachers make up their sermons so that the learned understand their own theology, and the unlearned theirs...
There are also preachers who dwell in the south (of London) who preach altogether that evils are to be shunned...
The preachers in the west further described.
When (the Moravians) are asked why their preachers are clothed in blue... they dare not say that they should be clothed like the English preachers in a black gown. Explained.
Many of these (celestial spiritual Angels) are preachers in the Third Heaven.
When a preacher comes to these harlots, they hold psalm-books in their hands, from phantasy, and thus deceive the preachers.
The delight of natural love falsities the Word chiefly in preachers.
So if anyone is listening to a preacher, and he says that he speaks from God, from zeal for their souls, even those who do not love God, and who believe nothing, may be affected, and love him...
Holy Spirit. 4. 8. The Divine meant by the Holy Spirit proceeds... through the clergy to the laity, through preachings...
All things which the priests preach from the Word about faith... charity, conversion, repentance fall as it were into a bucket, when orthodoxy enters and explains them... All things are overthrown.
